description: The secret to long-term business success isn’t a quick cash grab—it’s the art of delayed gratification. By intentionally working for free for that first client, this entrepreneur focused on over-delivering and building a relationship that lasted 16 years. Sometimes, giving away value upfront is the ultimate investment in a client who will eventually become your biggest advocate. A masterclass in entrepreneurship for anyone playing the long game. #businessstrategy #entrepreneurmindset #delayedgratification #startupadvice #successmindset
